ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial dealings of companies and individuals involved in child care fraud, including the Feeding Our Future program
questions: What are the financial ties between the companies and individuals involved?
How much money was allegedly funneled through the Feeding Our Future program?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in the child care industry. By analyzing the financial dealings of the companies and individuals involved, we may uncover a web of deceit and corruption that goes beyond just one program.
